{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check number of patients after deduplication
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}")

# Check number of sites and their names
print(f"Unique sites: {data_dedup['site'].unique().tolist()}")

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by site:\n", response_rate_by_site)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"The site with the highest response rate is {best_site} with a rate of {best_rate:.3f}")"}
